title: Riung language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Flores, Indonesia
extract: Riung is a language of central Flores, in East Nusa Tenggara Province, Indonesia. It has sometimes been considered a dialect of Manggarai to the west, but is only marginally intelligible with it.
